atelier.start.title: Start a sketch
atelier.start.copies: An example opens as a copy in {path}: change anything.
atelier.start.welcome: Zinc is TypeScript for making things: drawings that move, games, apps with buttons, 3D, sound, programs for small boards. A sketch is one folder of code: write it, press {run}, and its window opens.
atelier.start.learn: New to code? The lessons start from a window and a shape.
atelier.start.templates: Or start a real app from a template:
atelier.start.new: New sketch: how do you want to write it?
atelier.style.drawing.text: Redraw the whole picture every frame, like Processing (zinc:gfx).
atelier.style.scene.text: Objects that draw themselves, like ActionScript 3 (zinc:stage).
atelier.style.canvas.text: The web's canvas calls: paths, fills, gradients (zinc:canvas).
atelier.style.interface.text: Buttons and text described in JSX, like React (zinc:ui).
atelier.template.created: {name} is ready, made from the {template} template
atelier.template.exists: {name} already exists in the sketchbook: choose another name
atelier.template.failed: The {template} template could not be made: see the console
atelier.tour.language.title: Choose your language
atelier.tour.language.text: Atelier speaks these languages. You can change it later in Tools > Language.
atelier.tour.welcome.title: Welcome to Zinc Atelier
atelier.tour.welcome.text: Here you write sketches: small programs that open a window to draw, move and play sounds. These examples are a good start.
atelier.tour.example.title: Open an example
atelier.tour.example.text: Click Hello: it opens as a copy that is yours to change.
atelier.tour.editor.title: The code
atelier.tour.editor.text: This is the code of the sketch. Colours show names, words and numbers. Try putting your name in place of Hello.
atelier.tour.run.title: Run it
atelier.tour.run.text: Press Run, or ⌘R. The sketch opens in its own window; close that window, or press the red square, to stop it.
atelier.tour.console.title: The console
atelier.tour.console.text: What the program prints shows here, with the steps that build it. A red line is a problem.
atelier.tour.error.title: A mistake and its fix
atelier.tour.error.text: The tour put a small mistake in the code: a red line marks it, and the status line says what is wrong. In the console, a click on its place opens it and a click on its code explains it. Fix it, or let the tour do it.
atelier.tour.completion.title: Help while you type
atelier.tour.completion.text: Type the start of a name and press Ctrl+Space: Atelier lists what exists and what each thing needs.
atelier.tour.palette.title: Every command
atelier.tour.palette.text: Everything Atelier can do is in one list: press ⌘⇧P and type a word.
atelier.tour.devices.title: Where it runs
atelier.tour.devices.text: Native runs on this computer. The ESP32 emulator needs no board. The boards and devices you pair show in this list.
atelier.tour.templates.title: Start your own
atelier.tour.templates.text: New sketch, at the top of the page, asks how you want to write it: Drawing, Scene, Canvas or Interface. A template is a project with its files ready: a game, a desktop app, a board. Help > Learn has lessons, from a window and a shape to an app with buttons.

atelier.sketch.no_code: The sketch has no code file
atelier.sketch.starter.drawing:
A new sketch: a circle that breathes. Run it with the button above (⌘R).
Try this: change 40 to 80, or 0x9388ff to 0xff8800, and run it again.
atelier.sketch.starter.scene:
A new sketch in the Scene style: the ball is an object that draws itself (zinc:stage). Run it with the button above (⌘R).
Try this: click the ball, then change 40 to 80 and run it again.
atelier.sketch.starter.canvas:
A new sketch in the Canvas style: the web's canvas calls draw a circle that breathes (zinc:canvas). Run it with the button above (⌘R).
Try this: change ctx.fill() to ctx.stroke(), or '#9388ff' to 'orange', and run it again.
atelier.sketch.starter.interface:
A new sketch in the Interface style: the screen is described once, in JSX (zinc:ui). Run it with the button above (⌘R).
Try this: change bg-[#9388ff] to bg-[#ff8800], or +1 to Click, and run it again.

atelier.project.title: Project
atelier.project.name: Name
atelier.project.no_permission: None: the app reads no file, opens no connection and starts no program.
atelier.project.undeclared: Not declared: files, network and processes are not checked. Allowing one thing starts the checks.
atelier.project.sketch_is: A sketch: a folder of code, run as it is.
atelier.project.project_is: A project adds a zinc.json: the app's name and version, its window, what it may do, its targets. It is what Build App and a device need to make an app of it.
atelier.project.not_object: zinc.json is left as it is: it is not a JSON object
atelier.project.save_first: Save zinc.json first: its tab has changes
atelier.project.bad_version: A version is digits and dots: 1.2.0
atelier.project.version_id: Version {version}; the app's id is {id} until zinc.json says another
atelier.project.small_window: A window is at least 64 x 64
atelier.project.bad_permission: {name} is not a permission (fs, net, process, camera, menu, tray, dialog, notification…)
atelier.project.made: This sketch is now a project: zinc.json holds its name, its id, its version and its entry
